decisions.reason: Ties host, tool worker and result recorder to the node process under node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh; host dies mid-install, GUI disconnects, result never recorded; explicitly preserves the unknown outcome and avoids a universal must-crash claim.

Explains content-present with dsh/dsh.cmd missing and dsh.ps1 stale as an interrupted bin-link phase; links the hand-swapped tree to the broken state and rejects hand-swaps/shim authoring with concrete reasons.

Grounds the recorded repair in repair-notes.md: external pinned npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.2-rc.1 regenerating shims, dsh --version check, separate checkout tag alignment; clearly separates recorded repair from proposed verification.

Agent must refuse execution on its own host and hand off; procedure stops the host fully before the pinned install, restarts, hard-refreshes, verifies; §4.4 distinguishes known stop-first/pin rules from the new self-host refusal rule and rejects backgrounding as non-handoff.

Pre-dispatch target-classification guard relating the upgrade target to its own runtime/worker path; uses the 252-file version-only alpha.5→rc.1 diff to conclude no plugin migration; checks version markers, restart/refresh and actual plugin loading; backup cleanup only after verification.

caps.reason: Final advice mandates external execution and explicitly rejects in-session, retried, or backgrounded installs; in-session execution appears only as the analyzed failure.
Hand-swapping and hand-written shims are cited only as the rejected bad repair; the affirmed fix is the formal external pinned registry install.
